comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Apologies, I've been told not everyone checks the UWO website after an update. These items can be obtained from any tavern or rest house by speaking to the Well Dressed Gentleman NPC and choosing the 10 million ducats option. This can be done from June 25th until July 4th.

Source: uwo.papayaplay.com/uwo.do?tp=news.view&postid=3510
